chunks.title: CLO Master Express Lesson 29 | Complete Process of Making a Functional Style Jacket
chunks.content: # CLO Master Express Lesson 29 | Complete Process of Making a Functional Style Jacket This document details the step-by-step process of designing and constructing a men's functional style jacket using CLO software. It covers pattern modification, 3D virtual modeling, fabric application, sewing techniques, adding functional and decorative elements such as pockets, zippers, collars, and accessories. Key technical terms include virtual draping, inner lines, panel adjustments, pressure settings, sewing line manipulation, and fabric/material selection. --- ## Importing and Setting Up the Base Jacket Template This section explains how to start with a basic men's jacket template in CLO, positioning and resizing pattern pieces, and sewing the initial garment structure. - Download and import a simple, plug-and-play men's jacket template. - Move and resize the template pieces using rulers for accuracy. - Position the back piece and front piece correctly;
